text:

text:

subject: Adaptive Deepfake Detector Launch // learnings Onfido & Veriff
text:

subject: Coffee Chat - Encord x Kaiser
text:
Hi [NAME],

I wanted to extend an invite to connect for a virtual coffee chat. We're in
the data annotation space and work with some of the top research labs at
Stanford Medicine, AbbVie, and leading healthtech startups like Flatiron.

The work Kaiser has been doing on responsible AI has been a tremendous step
forward, not only for Kaiser but for the medical industry as a whole. As
the team expands AI across more clinical use cases, I'd assume more data
needs to be ingested and evaluated which is an area we specialize in.

Ultimately, we believe that when building models in medical contexts, it's
important to be thorough and evaluate with the most precaution rather than
rushing to build, something I believe both Encord and Kaiser share as
values.

Let me know if you have availability next week or after, and we can set up
a virtual coffee.

subject: Edge MLOps data layer
text:

product roadmap is shaping up for this quarter.

With Edge serving as the [YEAR] revenue engine, AI chat summaries, profile

This is exactly where Encord operates. We work with over 200 ML teams,

Given the timing and overlap, would you be open to a 20-min chat to compare
notes? No pitch, no decks.

subject: Congrats on GM, [NAME] - a few things have changed since Wayve
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the new leadership role at GM!

It's been a while since we last crossed paths at Wayve. A lot has happened
since. We closed our Series C and have been heads down building the data
layer for Physical AI teams, including LiDAR, camera, and sensor data,
across annotation, curation, and model eval.

Curious what your thoughts are on building the training data flywheel from
scratch?

We see similar ADAS teams hit the same wall; just adding more data doesn't
move the needle, and identifying real coverage gaps before training becomes
the bottleneck. We work with Woven by Toyota and Phantom AI on this,
helping their perception teams move from manually driven data selection to
embedding-based curation at scale; teams typically see a 30% improvement in
annotation accuracy and 60% faster model iteration cycles.

Would love to have a quick 20-minute call next week. Would May 20 or May 21,
1 - 4 PM, work for you?

subject: aquabeam video curation bottleneck
text:
Hi [NAME],

I spoke briefly with someone on your team regarding AquaBeam footage and it
sounds like pulling the right clips for QA and model training is a real
bottleneck.

QA has to be perfect in surgery, but manually searching hours of video
doesn't scale. Proximie, Telos Health and Iterative Scopes use Encord Index
and Active to curate surgical video and run consensus QA on one platform.

We're able to surface the exact frames, overrides, and edge cases via
natural-language and metadata search then route them into multi-step
consensus workflows with HIPAA infrastructure and audit trails.

If you have time next week, I think you would get a lot of value seeing how
we approach this.

text:

subject: Ode to a Hawaiian Slice
text:
On golden crust, a debate is born,
Where pineapple sits, both praised and scorned.
Sweet yellow chunks beside the ham,
A controversial, glorious jam.
Tomato sauce, a crimson sea,
Cradles toppings in harmony.
Mozzarella stretches, white and warm,
Weathering every critic's storm.
Some say fruit has no place here,
That Italy weeps a single tear.
But one bold bite, and you'll confess
This island twist is pure finesse.
The smoky pig, the tropic fruit,
A flavor combo none refute
Once they've surrendered to the blend
Of sweet and salt that never ends.

By the way are you the right person for ML ops infrastructure? We work with
similar teams on the data pipeline side (annotation, curation, and model
eval) and I'd love to compare notes if it's in your domain.

subject: [COMPANY] Corp's AI Model Development - Solving Data Challenges
text:

curation, annotation, and model evaluation side.

overlap?
